windows.settings.title: FluxBrowser Settings
调整全局操作入口，覆盖播放、窗口和网页浏览动作。: Adjust global entry points for playback, window, and browsing actions.
决定窗口显示方式、沉浸切换后的保护策略，以及视频控制手感。: Control how the window behaves, how immersion mode is protected, and how video controls feel.
浏览器窗口始终置顶: Keep browser window always on top
即使不在沉浸模式，也让浏览器主窗口保持在其他窗口上方: Keep the main browser window above other windows even outside immersion mode
隐藏时保护播放状态和快捷键: Protect playback state and shortcuts when hidden
触发老板键隐藏窗口后暂停视频，并只保留老板键快捷键用于恢复窗口: Pause video after hiding the window with the boss key, and keep only the boss key shortcut available to restore it
保存常用窗口分辨率，快速切换不同观看场景。: Save commonly used window resolutions and switch quickly between viewing setups.
锁定纵横比，修改一边会自动计算另一边: Lock aspect ratio so changing one side updates the other automatically
书签可单独上传或下载，适合只处理内容数据的场景。: Bookmarks can be uploaded or downloaded separately when you only need content data.
使用 GitHub 仓库存放配置快照和书签记录。: Store config snapshots and bookmark records in a GitHub repository.
上传所有配置到云端: Upload all settings to the cloud
从云端下载覆盖本地: Download from cloud and overwrite local data
检查版本、下载更新，并在准备好时触发安装。: Check versions, download updates, and install when ready.
点击下方按钮检查更新: Click the button below to check for updates
需要排查问题时，再开启额外日志输出。: Enable extra logs only when you need to troubleshoot.
在控制台输出窗口位置和大小相关的调试信息: Output debug information about window position and size to the console
重置配置和日志前，先明确影响范围，避免误清理常用数据。: Review the impact before resetting configs and logs to avoid clearing frequently used data by mistake.
清理所有日志文件，包括主日志和调试日志: Clear all log files, including main and debug logs
重置窗口位置、大小和透明度为默认值: Reset window position, size, and opacity to defaults
重置应用设置，包括调试模式: Reset app settings, including debug mode
重置所有分辨率预设为默认值: Reset all resolution presets to defaults
注意：清理配置文件后需要重启应用才能生效: Note: changes take effect after restarting the app
应用将在保存后自动重启: The app will restart automatically after saving
